name: Advanced Sales Reports For WooCommerce
author: Anzar Ahmed

sections.description:
Advanced Sales Reports for WooCommerce extends the standard WooCommerce reports by offering detailed, customizable sales analytics through an intuitive dashboard.

This lightweight plugin helps store owners make data-driven decisions by providing in-depth insights into customer behavior, product performance, payment trends, stock levels, and more—all directly within the WordPress admin panel.

✅ Key Features

  • 📈 Interactive dashboard with KPIs and top-selling products/customers
  • 📦 Order reports with advanced filters
  • 🛍️ Product sales analytics
  • 👤 Customer sales insights
  • 📊 Order status breakdown
  • 💳 Payment method performance tracking
  • 🎟️ Coupon usage reports
  • 📉 Stock management and low-stock alerts
  • 🗂️ Product category sales performance
  • ⚡ AJAX-powered filters for faster data access

Seamlessly integrated under the Sales Report section in your WordPress dashboard, this plugin gives you actionable business intelligence—without performance overhead.

Arbitrary section

Future features planned:
* CSV and Excel export.
* Email scheduling of reports.
* Advanced date filters (quarterly, yearly).
sections.installation:
🛠️ Installation
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/advanced-sales-reports-for-woocommerce/ or install it via the WordPress plugin directory.
2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
3. Navigate to Sales Report → Dashboard in the WordPress admin menu to start analyzing your data.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce installed?

Yes, WooCommerce must be active for this plugin to work.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. It only loads in the WordPress admin panel and uses AJAX to optimize performance.

Can I export the reports?

Not yet. Export functionality (CSV/Excel) is planned for a future release.

Do you create custom reports based on specific business requirements?

Currently, the plugin offers predefined reports. However, custom report development can be considered based on specific use cases or requests. Please contact the developer for more information.
